people.name: Simon
people.line: Sorcerer in Samaria who tried to buy the Holy Spirit's power.

translations.web: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”
translations.bsb: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”
translations.kjv: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
translations.asv: And Simon answered and said, Pray ye for me to the Lord, that none of the things which ye have spoken come upon me.
